name: Diana
notes: Opening: Moonfall (R) is cast at t=0 as the engine's opening ult cast; its beam lands 0.25s (cast) + 1s (delay) later.

Crescent Strike (Q) is cast the instant it is off cooldown, applying Moonlight and immediately followed by Lunar Rush (E) in the same instant to consume Moonlight, dealing E's damage and dropping E's current cooldown to 0.25s; this Q-then-E pair repeats on Q's cooldown, which bottlenecks the loop as the dossier's rotation describes.

Crescent Strike's bolt is modeled as hitting the single dummy once: the wiki's 'two projectiles with slightly different trajectories' is read as a visual/arc detail, not a double-hit on one target, since the common in-game reading is a single application of Q's listed damage and Moonlight per cast (an open question, resolved conservatively).

Lunar Rush's post-dash 'attempt a basic attack' is modeled as a normal attack reset (the next attack needs only a windup, not a full attack-period wait); the dash's own travel time is not modeled beyond this.
Only one Lunar Rush cooldown reset is assumed per Crescent Strike cast (the conservative reading of the unsettled question about chained resets mid-dash), matching how the Q-E pair is driven here.

Pale Cascade (W) is cast on cooldown; because the dummy is stationary and adjacent, all three orbs are treated as detonating instantly on cast, so its cooldown starts effectively at the cast rather than after a meaningful travel delay.
Moonfall's bonus damage per additional champion pulled does not apply against a single dummy, so only its base explosion damage is dealt.

Moonsilver Blade (P) gives Diana bonus attack speed at all times, tripled for 5s after casting any ability (Q/W/E/R); every third basic attack in a row consumes 2 stacks on-hit for bonus cleave magic damage. The 5s stack-decay timer is not modeled since Diana attacks far more often than every 5s in this fight, so stacks never lapse in practice.
Mana costs are not modeled: even the full Q/W/E/R rotation over a 15s fight stays well within a level-16 Diana's mana pool, so nothing here binds on mana.
